name: Unrecorded Night
overview: Unrecorded Night is a canceled mystery series by David Lynch that was developed for Netflix. Conceived as a long-form story set in Los Angeles, the project explored filmmaking and Old Hollywood and was unrelated to Twin Peaks. It entered pre-production before being halted during the COVID-19 pandemic and was ultimately never filmed. Following Lynch’s death, his daughter Jennifer Lynch revealed that the family intends to publish the scripts
